tools.name: search_plugins
tools.description: Search the PickAPlugin catalog of ChatGPT, Codex and Claude plugins, agent skills and MCP servers by keyword (e.g. 'memory', 'postgres', 'code review', 'pdf'). Paid featured listings come first and are marked featured=true; everything else is ranked by relevance, then GitHub stars.

tools.name: get_plugin
tools.description: Full details for one listing by its slug (from a search result or a pickaplugin.com/p/<slug> URL): summary, category, maker, repo, homepage, docs, install command, stars, license.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All PickAPlugin categories with plugin counts and links.

tools.name: top_plugins
tools.description: Top plugins overall or in one category: paid featured listings first (marked featured=true), then editor's picks, then the most-starred maintained projects.
